plugins.name: superb
plugins.description: Personal skill collection, invoked as superb:<skill>. craft turns a vague product idea into a decision-rich CRAFT.md brief without planning or coding; superpipeline drives a settled idea to a finished branch by composing the superpowers skills, with a zero-assumption question law, on-disk run state, two approval gates, reviewer fan-out, a recursive fix loop, and dependency waves for parallel implementers.
